outcome: Preterm delivery (PTD) before 37 and 34 gestational weeks
cohort: 38,719 singleton infants born in a tertiary centre in Madrid, Spain between 2010 and 2016 with available perinatal outcome data
finding: Infants of mothers from medium/low HDI countries had lower odds of LBW but higher odds of PTD, PE, and poor neonatal outcomes compared to infants of mothers from very high HDI countries.
birth_weight: Low birth weight (LBW) was an outcome
